title: Antigravity A1 Drone Gains Follow Me Bundle
excerpt: Antigravity has introduced a Follow Me accessory bundle for its A1 drone, featuring a watch and a ring remote for tracking and gestures.
body_html:
Antigravity has introduced a new accessory package for its A1 drone called the Follow Me bundle. The optional kit includes both a watch and a ring remote designed to provide precise tracking capabilities along with gesture control features.

Users can purchase the accessories separately as a bundle or choose the complete kit that includes the A1 drone itself. These new remote options aim to enhance how users interact with and operate the aircraft during flight.
